tab.title: Firewall
tab.noHost: Open the firewall from a host.
tab.error: Could not read the firewall on this host.
tab.disabled: Firewall is turned off for this host. Turn it on in the host settings.
tab.sudo: This host needs passwordless sudo, or a root login, to read and change the firewall.

rule.portHint: Leave empty for every port. Lists and ranges need TCP or UDP.
rule.addressHint: An address or a range like 10.0.0.0/8.
rule.serviceHint: A firewalld service name, instead of a port.

rules.stale: The rules changed on the host. Refresh and try again.

defaults.hint: What happens to traffic that no rule matches.

zones.hint: firewalld puts each network interface and source in a zone. A zone's target is what it does with traffic its rules don't match.

enable.off: The firewall is off, so none of these rules apply right now.
enable.allowSshHint: Keeps Termix and your own SSH logins working.
enable.timerHint: Turning it on starts a timer. If you don't press Keep in time, the host turns it off again by itself.

disable.title: Turn off the firewall?
disable.description: Every rule stops applying until you turn it on again.

install.none: This host has no firewall yet.
install.hint: Install one to get started. Nothing is turned on until you say so.
install.noPackageManager: Termix could not find a package manager it knows on this host.

lockout.title: This could lock Termix out
lockout.description: {{reason}}. If Termix can't connect after the change, the host undoes it by itself when the timer runs out. Go ahead anyway?

pending.started: Change applied. Press Keep to make it stay.
pending.left: Undone in {{seconds}} s unless you press Keep
pending.expired: Time ran out, the host is undoing the change
pending.unreachable: Termix could not connect after the change
pending.gone: Time ran out and the host already undid the change.
pending.first: Keep or undo the last change first.

fail2ban.notInstalled: Fail2ban is not installed. It bans addresses that fail to log in too often.
fail2ban.stopped: Fail2ban is installed but not running.
fail2ban.counts: {{failed}} failing now | {{totalFailed}} failed | {{totalBanned}} banned in total
fail2ban.selfDescription: Termix connects from this address. Banning it cuts Termix off from this host.

watch.start: Alert me when this firewall changes

card.title: Firewalls
card.empty: No hosts have Firewall turned on.

rulesets.title: Firewall rule sets
rulesets.hint: Save a list of rules and add it to many hosts at once. Applying only adds missing rules, it never removes any.
rulesets.loadFailed: Could not load your rule sets.
rulesets.name: Name
rulesets.noRules: No rules in this set yet.
rulesets.noHosts: No hosts have Firewall turned on.
rulesets.deleteHint: Rules it already added to hosts stay.
rulesets.applyDescription: Missing rules are added on each host. Each host gets the SSH lockout check, and a host Termix can't reach afterwards undoes the change by itself.
rulesets.waiting: Added, but Termix could not connect afterwards. The host will undo it.

use.title: Use Firewall
use.description: Open the Firewall tab on hosts you can reach. Changes also need edit access to the host.

enable.label: Firewall
enable.description: Show the Firewall tab for this host to manage its firewall over SSH.

useSudo.label: Use sudo
useSudo.description: Run firewall commands with passwordless sudo when the login is not root.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Show the firewall but block every change from Termix.

sshGuard.label: SSH lockout check
sshGuard.description: Stop and ask before a change that looks like it would block SSH from Termix.

rollbackSeconds.label: Undo timer
rollbackSeconds.description: Seconds you get to press Keep after a risky change before the host undoes it.

confirmAll.label: Timer on every change
confirmAll.description: Use the undo timer for every change, not only the risky ones.

showPanel.label: Firewall panel
showPanel.description: Offer the firewall panel beside SSH terminals for this host.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the firewall panel with a terminal
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the firewall panel when a terminal opens on a host that has it.

companionSide.label: Firewall panel side
companionSide.description: Where the panel sits next to the terminal.

companionSize.label: Firewall panel size
companionSize.description: Width, or height at the bottom, in pixels.

companionEdgeButton.label: Firewall panel edge button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the terminal edge to open the panel.

manager.title: Firewall
manager.disabled: Turn on Firewall in this host's settings to manage its firewall here.

portAllowed.title: Port is allowed
portAllowed.description: Whether an allow rule for this port exists. Use it to watch hosts for drift.

operations.sourceHint: An address or range. Empty means anywhere.
